windows_bcp.notes: BCP 0.7.0 adds offline-first mission stall detection and bounded durable resume intents while preserving low-resource lifecycle, telemetry, Telegram watchdog, and hash-pinned self-update.

android_b_edge.notes: B-EDGE 2.1.0 same-identity Evergreen APK is v2/v3 signed, hash/readback verified, and published in place at the stable Drive CURRENT location. Field install and runtime telemetry are pending.

nexus.notes: Nexus 0.2.1 preserves the field-shaped portable runtime and adds Rich Cockpit V10 parity: rich-first live cards with mandatory V9 fallback, modern callbacks, and all four report caches.
